# pantechdynamics_disk_offerings (Data Source)

Lists the disk offerings a volume can be ordered with. Use an offering's slug as the disk_offering_slug of a pantechdynamics_volume. The storage type matters: on staging, volumes with local storage attached to instances and shared ones did not.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pantechdynamics_disk_offerings" "all" {}

# Offerings whose volumes can be attached on staging.
output "local_offerings" {
  value = [for o in data.pantechdynamics_disk_offerings.all.disk_offerings : o.slug if o.storage_type == "local"]
}

# Offerings priced by the gigabyte, which take a size_gb.
output "customized_offerings" {
  value = [for o in data.pantechdynamics_disk_offerings.all.disk_offerings : o.slug if o.custom_size]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `disk_offerings` (Attributes List) The available disk offerings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disk_offerings))
- `id` (String) Always "disk_offerings". Present because every data source needs an id.

<a id="nestedatt--disk_offerings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disk_offerings`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Currency of the price.
- `custom_size` (Boolean) True when the size is chosen with size_gb when the volume is ordered.
- `hourly_price_minor` (Number) Price per hour, in minor currency units (for example kobo). For a customized offering this is the price per gigabyte per hour.
- `name` (String) Display name of the offering.
- `size_gb` (Number) Size in gigabytes for a fixed offering, or null for a customized one.
- `slug` (String) Stable short name of the offering, used as disk_offering_slug.
- `storage_type` (String) "shared" or "local".
